visual_elements.description: Fully-connected NN sketch inside a blue rounded-rectangle border. Top-left: fanned stack of bold labels — 'X₃' in a white box on top, with 'X₄', 'X₂', 'X₁' cascading diagonally beneath it toward the inputs (X₅ not visible) [?]. Five input clusters stacked vertically; each cluster = four small pale circles (labels x'₁, x'₂, x'₃, x'₄; cluster 3 labeled x₁, x₂, x₃, x₄) fanned diagonally and wired into a larger pink circle labeled X₁/X₂/X₃/X₄/X₅ (bold black text, dark outline). Thin lines (predominantly blue, with magenta and green for lower groups) fan from the X nodes to three Σ neurons at roughly 25%, 50%, 75% of the panel height: each Σ neuron is a red-outlined circle with green diagonal-hatch fill and a black 'Σ', with a gray hatched semicircle beneath it. Weight labels along the lines, top to bottom: W₁₁ W₂₁ W₃₁ W₄₁ (blue), W₁₂ W₂₂ W₃₂ W₄₂ (blue), W₁₃ W₂₃ W₃₃ W₄₃ (magenta), W₁₄ W₂₄ W₃₄ W₄₄ (green). Red bold outputs y₁, y₂, y₃ to the right of each Σ neuron.

Wheat/tan rounded rectangle with a thin dark-red border containing four left-aligned text lines: 'Design FF NN with the following Considerations:' (red bold italic), then 'Activation:  Linear', 'Bias:  Zeros', 'Inputs:  All Words Within Same Paragraph (X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄, X₅)' — prompts in red bold italic, values in blue bold, values column-aligned.

Matrix-multiplication schematic inside a large white rounded rectangle with blue border. Left column: five peach rounded rectangles (orange-red outline) stacked vertically with small gaps, each tagged at its top-right corner with bold Y₁/Y₂/Y₃/Y₄/Y₅ and containing four small squares labeled y₁, y₂, y₃, y₄ with alternating pale-yellow/pale-green fills. Beside the Y₃ row: red '=' + blue bold 'Linear'. Five horizontal orange dotted connector lines with tiny arrowheads join each Y row to the matching X row. Middle column: bold black labels X₁–X₅, each followed by a rounded rectangle (dark-red outline; the X₃ row filled light blue as a highlight) containing four white circles with red outlines labeled x₁, x₂, x₃, x₄. Right: a pale-green rounded panel holding a 4×4 grid of cells — row 1: W₁₁ W₂₁ W₃₁ W₄₁ (blue text on pale-blue cells); row 2: W₁₂ W₂₂ W₃₂ W₄₂ (magenta text on pale-pink cells); row 3: W₁₃ W₂₃ W₃₃ W₄₃ (magenta text on pale-pink cells); row 4: W₁₄ W₂₄ W₃₄ W₄₄ (green text on pale-green cells). Then a red bold '+' and a vertical column of four pale-green boxes each containing a bold black '0'; a tall blue right curly brace '}' spans the full height at the far right (a matching tall blue left brace appears at the left edge of the X₁–X₅ column [?]).
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with red bold '14'.
